license.rule: Any future copied or substantially adapted implementation must record exact upstream paths and commit and carry all applicable Kaneo and actual-origin notices.

dispositionDefinitions.copy: Substantial source reuse is permitted only after file-level ancestry and attribution gates pass.
dispositionDefinitions.adapt: Recreate the component or interaction structure against WorkMesh-owned view models and contracts.
dispositionDefinitions.reference: Use only as design/test inspiration; implement independently.
dispositionDefinitions.reject: Do not import into WorkMesh implementation or authority boundaries.

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: conditional; no dependency is approved by GEN-3

risk.summary: Incomplete COSS/shadcn lineage could make direct copying non-compliant; default to rewrite until resolved.

candidateUnits.rationale: Business-authority-free component APIs and state variants are reusable, but registry ancestry is incomplete.
attribution: file-level COSS/shadcn lineage before any copy

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: conditional; Base UI selection belongs to GEN-4 architecture review

risk.summary: Focus, scroll-lock and client-boundary regressions can break accessibility and responsive flows.

candidateUnits.rationale: Overlay, focus and viewport semantics are valuable; Kaneo classes and Base UI coupling must not cross unchanged.
attribution: Base UI and COSS notices where applicable

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: none required for the candidate contract; implementation may use the chosen UI foundation

risk.summary: Error rendering or retry ownership could leak details or create false recovery state.

candidateUnits.rationale: Accelerates consistent loading, empty and error states.
attribution: COSS lineage for empty.tsx before copy

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: defer Tailwind decision to GEN-4; no font or styling dependency is approved

risk.summary: Copying CSS can silently pull fonts, global conflicts or inaccessible contrast into WorkMesh.

candidateUnits.rationale: Reference semantic tokens, dark mode and reduced motion without copying fonts or editor CSS.
attribution: design record cites pinned Kaneo commit

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: conditional on the selected overlay/icon foundation; do not import Kaneo routing

risk.summary: Navigation visibility must never become an authorization decision or alter Next routing semantics.

candidateUnits.rationale: Sidebar hierarchy, collapse and workspace/project navigation are useful; routing and authority must be WorkMesh-owned.
gates: server authorization independent of menu visibility

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: conditional on the selected Sheet primitive; no additional settings dependency

risk.summary: Responsive Sheet behavior and focus restoration can regress across breakpoints.

candidateUnits.rationale: Desktop aside plus mobile Sheet is a high-value post-v2.12.1 pattern.

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: reuse only the GEN-4-approved dialog/command primitives; reject TanStack Router

risk.summary: Stale or hidden command results could expose or invoke unauthorized actions.

candidateUnits.rationale: Reuse grouping, recent/search and shortcuts; replace TanStack routing and search DTOs.

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: conditional adoption of dnd-kit only with non-drag parity and bundle approval

risk.summary: Optimistic drag can lose revision/authorization failures or exclude keyboard and touch users.

candidateUnits.rationale: Sensors, overlay and card/column composition help; Kaneo ProjectWithTasks and mutation/store coupling must be removed.

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: conditional dnd-kit reuse; no client cache dependency is approved

risk.summary: Bulk partial failure, client-side pagination or stale selection can misrepresent durable state.

candidateUnits.rationale: Dense rows, section collapse and bulk affordances improve core Human flow.

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: conditional on the selected Sheet primitive; no Kaneo data/state dependency

risk.summary: A reused single-assignee or mutation model would collapse Human responsibility and Agent execution authority.

candidateUnits.rationale: Sheet/full-page and content/property layout can be reused through a WorkMesh authority-safe view model.

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: conditional Lucide icon use; no Kaneo task model dependency

risk.summary: Dense metadata can hide Human/Agent distinctions, overflow or final-state semantics.

candidateUnits.rationale: Metadata density and display tests help, while Kaneo single-user assignee semantics are rejected.

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: defer all editor dependencies to a separate rich-text architecture and content-safety decision

risk.summary: Rich content, mentions and uploads create content-safety, provenance, bundle and authority risks.

candidateUnits.rationale: Large Tiptap/workspace/upload/mention coupling makes early extraction unsafe and expensive.

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: none authorized; any future Tiptap dependency follows the rich-text decision

risk.summary: Foreign member identifiers can reveal or bind unauthorized actors and resources.

candidateUnits.rationale: Kaneo workspace-member IDs and custom serialization do not match WorkMesh Actor kinds and visibility.
attribution: Kaneo/Tiptap notice if an algorithm is copied

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: defer Mermaid and DOMPurify together to a separate content-safety and license gate

risk.summary: Rendered SVG/URLs can create content injection, CSP, isolation and license obligations.

candidateUnits.rationale: Strict rendering patterns are informative but not a complete WorkMesh content-safety boundary.

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: none; use WorkMesh-owned form and server-state stack

risk.summary: Client-only success, secret round trips or direct side effects would violate WorkMesh outbox authority.

candidateUnits.rationale: Presentation hierarchy helps, but channel model, secret fields and external effects differ.
attribution: Kaneo MIT for any presentation copy

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: none beyond Node tooling; i18next runtime remains a separate decision

risk.summary: Copied tooling without exact provenance or fixtures could generate nondeterministic or incomplete catalogs.

candidateUnits.rationale: Standalone deterministic tooling can reduce missing/extra keys; Kaneo locale content is excluded.
attribution: file headers and third-party notice with exact paths/ref

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: none; translations are not imported

risk.summary: Unverified per-string rights and incompatible domain terminology make copied translations unsafe.

candidateUnits.rationale: Kaneo prose and terminology are not WorkMesh domain truth and per-string provenance is incomplete.

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: reject @tanstack/react-router for WorkMesh

risk.summary: Mixed router lifecycles would break deep links, loaders and application ownership.

candidateUnits.rationale: Router, URL parameter and loader lifecycles are incompatible.
gates: independent Next route and deep-link tests

candidateUnits.target: WorkMesh contracts and API adapters only
candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: reject Kaneo client data and mutation stack; React Query remains independently deferred

risk.summary: Whole-object client updates and cache invalidation can bypass revision, idempotency and durable event authority.

candidateUnits.rationale: Kaneo whole-task updates and cache invalidation do not encode WorkMesh revision, idempotency, actor/session and durable-event authority.

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: none; do not adopt Kaneo WebSocket authority

risk.summary: Transient broadcasts cannot replace durable cursor replay and restart recovery.

candidateUnits.rationale: WebSocket broadcasts and query invalidation are not durable cursor/event replay.

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: none; Better Auth and Kaneo credential flows are excluded

risk.summary: Mixing Human browser credentials with Agent Session/Delegation authority would break identity boundaries.

candidateUnits.rationale: Better Auth organization/role/device/API-key semantics are not WorkMesh Human/Agent/Service and Session/Delegation authority.
gates: retain WorkMesh authentication and authorization contracts

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: none; no Kaneo backend, permission or MCP dependency

risk.summary: Importing upstream authority code would create a second backend and permission model.

candidateUnits.rationale: These are Kaneo authority implementations, not presentation layers.
gates: never change WorkMesh domain/contracts/MCP authority to fit upstream UI

candidateUnits.target: WorkMesh install UX may reference documentation only
candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: none; no topology or deployment dependency

risk.summary: Adopting upstream topology could collapse WorkMesh API/Web/Worker/MCP and migration boundaries.

candidateUnits.rationale: Kaneo topology and migration assumptions differ from WorkMesh API/Web/Worker/MCP boundaries.

candidateUnits.dependencyDecision: none; fonts and brand assets are excluded

risk.summary: Unknown font licensing and non-portable branding create legal and product-identity risk.

candidateUnits.rationale: Brand assets are not portable and font license files are not fully established at the pinned ref.
gates: separately verified font provenance and checksums

dependencies.name: @base-ui/react
dependencies.gate: Only with selected UI foundation plus Next client-boundary and a11y tests.

dependencies.name: @dnd-kit/core
dependencies.gate: Requires non-drag alternative, keyboard/touch E2E and conflict rollback.

dependencies.name: @tanstack/react-query
dependencies.gate: May not replace durable state/event cursor; introduce only for demonstrated cache need.

dependencies.name: @tiptap/react
dependencies.gate: Separate rich-text contract, bundle, paste/upload and SSR decision.

dependencies.name: tailwindcss
dependencies.gate: Major UI-foundation choice; do not introduce incidentally.

dependencies.name: dompurify
dependencies.gate: Choose applicable license and complete separate content-safety review.

dependencies.name: mermaid
dependencies.gate: Late optional dynamic import, render isolation and bundle/performance gate.

dependencies.name: lucide-react
dependencies.gate: Preserve ISC notice and exclude brand marks.

dependencies.name: framer-motion
dependencies.gate: Prefer CSS and reduced motion unless measured need justifies bundle cost.

dependencies.name: i18next
dependencies.gate: First define WorkMesh glossary/catalog; never copy Kaneo translations.

unverified: Verified signer identity for pinned commits
Dependency vulnerability and upstream security posture because security scanning was excluded
